intro.en: Standard game-bug TYPES to check for:
intro.zh: 需要检查的标准游戏 bug 类型：

description.en: objects clipping into each other or into floors/walls; objects floating in mid-air; abnormal scale vs identical siblings; duplicated/overlapping objects; implausible layout.
description.zh: 物体相互穿插，或穿入地板／墙体；物体悬浮在空中；相对于其他相同物体，尺度异常；物体重复／重叠；不合理的布局。

description.en: walking through solid-looking objects; invisible blockers where nothing is visible; falling through the floor; objects moving on their own with no cause.
description.zh: 穿过看起来是实体的物体；看不到任何物体的位置存在不可见阻挡；穿过地板并坠落；物体没有原因地自行移动。

description.en: missing textures (flat unnatural colors); objects invisible from some viewpoints yet present from others; objects rendering through walls/occluders; wrong materials; shadow/light anomalies.
description.zh: 纹理缺失（平坦、不自然的颜色）；物体从某些视角不可见，从其他视角却可见；物体穿透墙壁／遮挡物被渲染出来；材质错误；阴影／光照异常。

description.en: an object that is gone (or elsewhere) when you look back at it; abrupt state changes over time; things reverting by themselves. Re-checking a spot you saw earlier is a valid and useful test.
description.zh: 回头再看时，物体消失或出现在其他位置；状态随时间发生突然变化；物体或状态自行恢复。重新检查之前观察过的位置，是有效且有用的测试方法。

description.en: assets that do not belong in the scene; objects placed where they make no sense; impossible spatial connections.
description.zh: 不属于当前场景的资产；物体被放置在不合理的位置；不可能成立的空间连接关系。

principle.en: Normal scene content (plants, curtains, banners, pillars, furniture, decorations) is NOT a bug by itself: judge against the scene's own consistency - identical elements should look and behave identically.
principle.zh: 正常场景内容（植物、窗帘、旗帜、柱子、家具、装饰物）本身不构成 bug：应依据场景自身的一致性判断——相同元素应具有一致的外观和行为。

name.zh: 交互后物体运动轨迹异常
视角／距离相关的外观异常
